description: Defines the CompareField class which extends BaseCompare to perform comparison operations between fields in a minilang process, specifically comparing the current field to another field specified by an attribute.

classes.name: CompareField
classes.description: A class that compares the current field to another specified field within a minilang operation context.

methods.name: CompareField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CompareField with XML element attributes and a processing context.
